verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs state that the server offers an Anthropic Messages API alongside its OpenAI-compatible API and gRPC support, which directly covers the story. That claim appears only as a one-line feature bullet. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on the Anthropic messages endpoint (path, supported fields, streaming and tool-use parity), example requests, and independent or hands-on confirmation that Anthropic clients work against it.
